data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: models
ui_devex.summary: TensorFlow Models 是一个包含多种预建机器学习模型和实现示例的开源项目，为开发者提供了快速构建和部署AI应用的起点，避免了从零开始的繁琐工作。该项目通过计算机视觉、自然语言处理等领域的多样化实现，展示了TensorFlow框架的实际应用模式和优化技巧，特别适合学习如何设计高效模型架构。开发者可以直接使用这些模型进行实验，根据具体需求调整网络结构，或深入研究代码来掌握TensorFlow的高级功能和最佳实践方法，从而加速自己的AI项目开发进程。
ui_devex.summary_en: The TensorFlow Models repository is a comprehensive collection of pre-built machine learning models and implementation examples that help developers quickly prototype and deploy AI solutions without starting from scratch. It showcases TensorFlow's capabilities through diverse implementations ranging from computer vision to natural language processing, demonstrating practical design patterns and optimization techniques. Developers can use these models as starting points for their own projects, modify architectures for specific tasks, or study the code to learn TensorFlow best practices and advanced techniques.
